subject: Dedicated capacity demo request — Olive AI / throughput & latency
messages:
From: Olivia Jeong <olivia@olive.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Dedicated capacity demo request — Olive AI

Hi Marissa,

We just completed a self-serve signup and are interested in a demo of Redwood Dedicated. A quick overview of our needs:
- Peak throughput: ~120 qps (concurrent inference across 8 model endpoints)
- Typical request size: 512 tokens / response ~150 tokens
- Latency SLO: p95 <= 250ms for short prompt paths, burst tolerance to 1s for long tails
- KV cache usage: heavy (multi-turn chat history), would like to understand prefix/KV caching behavior

I've attached a small telemetry sample and a short doc with our expected traffic pattern. We'd like a demo focused on Dedicated capacity — particularly throughput, latency, and predictable SLAs.

Availability this week: afternoons PT are best (Tue–Thu). Who from your side should join for a technical deep-dive?

Thanks,
Olivia Jeong
Head of Platform
Olive AI
attachments: olive_telemetry_sample.csv

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Jeong <olivia@olive.ai>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-25T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity demo request — Olive AI

Hi Olivia — great to meet you and thanks for the telemetry.

We'd love to run a Dedicated-focused demo that covers: routing/pinning models to pools, autoscale/burst behavior, batching impacts on latency/cost, and how KV/prefix caching preserves latency at scale. I looped in Aditya (SDR) and Dylan (Solutions/AE) — Dylan will lead the technical portion.

Proposed times (PT):
- Tue 6/25 3:00–3:45pm
- Wed 6/26 2:00–2:45pm
- Thu 6/27 4:00–4:45pm

If one of those works, I'll send a calendar invite and include a short one-pager on Redwood Dedicated. Also: can you confirm whether you need a dedicated staging environment or if you're OK running a smoke test against a hosted test pool?

Quick ask for the demo prep: any SLAs or compliance items we should be aware of (SOC2, DPA, region constraints)?

Best,
Marissa Cole
SDR, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
phone: (415) 555-0123

From: Olivia Jeong <olivia@olive.ai>

Marissa — thanks for the quick follow-up. Wed 6/26 2:00pm PT works for us. Attendees on our side: myself, our infra lead Ben Castillo, and an ML engineer (Sara Li).

On the staging question: we'd prefer a dedicated staging environment to run a short throughput test if possible — specifically a short (10–15 minute) ramp to 120 qps to measure p50/p95/p99 latency. If that's not available, a hosted test pool with configured pooling/batching is okay.

Compliance: we require SOC 2 and DPA; we've already reviewed your public SOC2 attestation but may request supporting evidence during procurement. Region: US-only data for now.

I attached the telemetry sample earlier (CSV) and a short note with burst characteristics.

— Olivia
